parent_center.checked: Verified PTI center; 600 W. Virginia Street, Suite 501, Milwaukee, WI 53204; (877) 374-0511 (Milwaukee) or (877) 374-4677 (statewide); wifacets@wifacets.org

note: Wisconsin's Part B procedural safeguards are available through Wisconsin FACETS PTI center, which maintains materials in English, Spanish, and Hmong. Wisconsin DPI special education pages have access issues; contact FACETS or Wisconsin Wayfinder for comprehensive parent rights information.
